purpose: Teach: 芥川/ビルマ/ベネズエラ/茅ヶ崎/ナイロビ/鈴鹿/ホノルル/テレビ東京

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが芥川龍之介の短編を愛読された
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he loved Akutagawa Ryunosuke's short stories.
lines.style: Gentle, reminiscent opening. Soft vocal weight on the memory. Slightly distant gaze. Warm but wistful — a quiet man retrieving an old detail he's held carefully.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、ビルマ戦線の体験を語って下さったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, and your father told us about his time on the Burma front, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Bright, present warmth. Reaches back to him with her affection. A gentle correction, almost playful — she's remembering too, and wants him to know it. The endearment 「あなた」lands soft and genuine.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがベネズエラのサルサに興味を持たれた
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he became interested in Venezuelan salsa.
lines.style: Same wistful register as before, but with a slight shift — curiosity this time, not melancholy. He's turning the spotlight to another corner of memory. Still measured, still that old man's gentle pacing.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、茅ヶ崎にお別荘をお持ちだったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your father kept a vacation home in Chigasaki, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Playful warmth now — she's engaging with his game. Knows he's testing something. A small laugh in the breath before speaking. Still reaching toward him, but with a light touch.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがナイロビ駐在のお話をされた
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he used to talk about his posting in Nairobi.
lines.style: The same gentle retrieval, but now with a sense of reaching further back — older memories, wider world. Still wistful, but grounded. Quiet respect for a life well-lived.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、鈴鹿のF1日本グランプリをご覧になったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your father saw the Japanese Grand Prix at Suzuka, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: She's delighted now — caught the game, playing it back to him with genuine joy. Quick, warm affection in the rhythm. The endearment lands with a small smile underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんと新婚旅行でホノルルへ行った
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he and I took a honeymoon trip to Honolulu.
lines.style: A shift — he moves into his own memory now, not his father-in-law's. Tender vulnerability. A pause before 「ホノルル」 — he's offering something precious. Slower, more present than the others.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、テレビ東京の番組をご覧になってたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your father used to watch those shows on TV Tokyo, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Softer closing — she meets him at his vulnerability with equal gentleness. No more playfulness. She knows what he just gave her. A closing breath, almost a whisper of agreement. Tender, certain.
